meta.tagline: Command center for an autonomous analyst — paper only

LIVE.label: Live
LIVE.hint: Read from the source just now and still inside its staleness budget.

STALE.label: Stale
STALE.hint: Really observed, but outside its freshness budget — read with care.

UNKNOWN.label: Unknown
UNKNOWN.hint: Not observed. You see a dash instead of a number; nothing was guessed.

DEMO.label: Demo
DEMO.hint: Synthetic sample data. It makes no claim about any real market.

PAPER.label: Paper
PAPER.hint: Simulated book. Real trading is disabled and no money is involved.

paper.noticeShort: Every amount here is paper; no real money is involved.
paper.noticeLong: This dashboard runs in paper mode only. Every number you see is simulation output: real trading is disabled, no exchange key exists, and no capital ever moves.
paper.tooltip: Execution is paper-only. Live data requires a connected source; otherwise the state stays Unknown.
paper.acknowledgement: I understand these numbers are not real
paper.unitNote: The accounting unit is paper USDT, not a real balance.
paper.balanceDisclaimer: The paper starting balance is an arbitrary figure for testing rules, not your capital.

empty.noData: No data has been recorded yet.
empty.noConnection: No connection to the data source; the state is shown as Unknown.
empty.allUnknown: Nothing was observed; every cell is Unknown.
empty.demoOnly: This section is filled with demo data.
empty.waitingFirstCycle: Waiting for the first system cycle.

errors.timeout: The data source did not answer within its deadline.
errors.unauthorized: You do not have access to this section.
errors.parseFailed: The payload could not be parsed.
errors.stale: The data on screen is stale.
errors.rateLimited: The source is rate limiting requests.
errors.noKey: No access key is configured for this source.
errors.costBlocked: This source is paid and currently blocked.
errors.outOfPolicy: Reading this source is outside AHOS policy.
errors.unknownState: System state is unknown; no number was substituted.
errors.contractMismatch: The payload does not match the ahos.contract/1 shape.
errors.contactHint: If it repeats, send the events with their trace IDs to audit.

tooltips.asOf: When this value was actually observed, not when the page loaded.
tooltips.freshnessColumn: Freshness of each value: live, stale, unknown or demo.
tooltips.unknownOverFabricated: If data cannot be read, AHOS shows Unknown; no number is invented.
tooltips.displayedVsRealizable: Displayed value is quantity times mark price. Realizable value is what could actually be recovered after slippage, fee, tax and network cost.
tooltips.paperOnly: Execution mode is paper only and real trading is disabled.
tooltips.killSwitch: The kill switch halts signal intake, order submission and auto exit. Only a human can reset it.
tooltips.humanGate: This action will not run without operator approval.
tooltips.score: Score from 0 to 100 based on recorded evidence; missing evidence means Unknown, not zero.
tooltips.demoData: This row is demo data, generated to exercise the interface.
tooltips.stalenessBudget: Each feed's freshness budget can be changed in Settings.
tooltips.appendOnly: Events are append-only: they are never edited and never deleted.
tooltips.clockSkew: Difference between the system clock and the reference clock. Large skew invalidates event ordering.
tooltips.noRealMoney: There is no path from this dashboard to real money.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: One look at paper equity, risk, departments and the newest signals.
overview.paperOnlyNotice: The amounts on this page are paper; no real money is involved.
overview.greeting: Hello {name}, the system is in paper mode.

equity.label: Paper equity
equity.hint: Cash plus the realizable value of open positions.

dailyPnl.label: Today's P&L
dailyPnl.hint: From the start of today until the last completed cycle.

maxDrawdown.label: Max drawdown
maxDrawdown.hint: Largest peak-to-trough fall inside the visible range.

openPositions.label: Open positions
openPositions.hint: Paper positions that have not been closed yet.

exposure.label: Open exposure
exposure.hint: Share of equity currently sitting in open positions.

cash.label: Free cash
cash.hint: The unallocated part of the paper book.

riskLevel.label: Risk level
riskLevel.hint: Roll-up of limits and circuit breakers.

uptime.label: Uptime
uptime.hint: Continuous time the system has been up.

unknownShare.label: Share of unknown data
unknownShare.hint: How many cells on this page have no observed value.

equityCurve.title: Paper equity curve — 7 days
equityCurve.subtitle: One point per hour; hours without data are shown as gaps.
equityCurve.gapNote: No data was recorded in this hour; the line is not continuous.

riskGauge.title: Risk gauge
riskGauge.subtitle: Current state of limits and circuit breakers.
riskGauge.empty: Risk has not been evaluated yet.

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Twelve departments and the current health of each.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Markets the operator is watching.
watchlist.empty: No market has been added to the watchlist.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: Components, data sources and clock skew.

killSwitch.title: Kill switch
killSwitch.subtitle: Current state and the last drill.
killSwitch.engaged: Engaged — all automatic actions are halted.
killSwitch.locked: Locked — only the operator can reset it.

empty.title: No cycle has completed yet
empty.body: Until the first full cycle, everything here is Unknown. That is not an error; it is the absence of data.

errors.partial: Some cards have no data and are shown as Unknown.
errors.stale: The overview is stale; the last cycle did not complete.

tooltips.unknownShare: The unknown share tells you how much of this page actually has data.
tooltips.cycle: One cycle means: read data, evaluate, decide, record the event.
tooltips.paperEquity: Paper equity starts from an agreed balance and only moves through simulated trades.

markets.title: Markets
markets.subtitle: Forty markets across crypto, forex, indices and metals. A price is shown only if it was observed.
markets.paperOnlyNotice: Prices and volumes on this page are paper; no real trade is executed.

detail.title: Market file: {symbol}
detail.noProvider: No source is connected for this market.

empty.title: No market to show
empty.body: Either the market list is empty or the filters left no rows.
empty.noProviders: No data source is connected; every price stays Unknown.
empty.unknownOnly: All remaining rows have no data.

errors.timeout: The price source did not answer in time.
errors.stale: Prices are stale; last observation was {time}.

tooltips.spread: Distance between best bid and best ask, in basis points.
tooltips.liquidity: Depth you can actually exit into, not the whole pool size.
tooltips.priceImpact: Price impact of a reference-sized order.
tooltips.demoGrid: Demo prices are generated on a stepped grid so they cannot be mistaken for real quotes.
tooltips.marketState: Open, closed, auction or halted; Unknown means the session state was not read.

positions.title: Paper positions
positions.subtitle: The simulated book. Every position shows the displayed-vs-realizable pair.
positions.paperOnlyNotice: Every amount on this page is paper; real trading is disabled and no money moves.

empty.title: You have no paper position
empty.body: Until a signal reaches execution, this table stays empty. Empty means absent data, not zero profit.
empty.noClosed: No position has been closed yet.

errors.closeFailed: Closing the position failed; it is still open.
errors.markUnavailable: Mark price unavailable; P&L stays Unknown.
errors.stale: Mark price is stale; last observation {time}.

tooltips.displayedValue: Quantity times mark price — the number a naive interface would show.
tooltips.realizableValue: What could actually be recovered after slippage, fee, tax and network cost.
tooltips.honestyGap: The gap between the two is the hidden cost of exiting.
tooltips.trapped: This position cannot be exited; its value exists on paper only.
tooltips.timeStop: If no reason to hold remains by this time, the position is closed.
tooltips.leverage: Leverage in the AHOS paper book is always one.

signals.title: Signals
signals.subtitle: Output of the analysis departments and the expert council. Prices are references, not orders.
signals.paperOnlyNotice: Suggested sizes and prices on this page are paper and feed the simulation only.

detail.title: Signal file: {symbol}
detail.noEvidence: No evidence recorded; the score stays Unknown.

empty.title: There is no signal
empty.body: No trade is a valid answer too. No signal means evidence was insufficient, not that the market has no opportunity.
empty.noNew: No new signal has been emitted.

errors.actFailed: Paper execution failed; the signal is still open.
errors.expired: This signal expired before your action.

tooltips.score: Score from 0 to 100 based on evidence; missing evidence is Unknown, not zero.
tooltips.horizon: How long the signal is valid for.
tooltips.entryRef: Reference price when the signal was emitted, not a guaranteed fill.
tooltips.invalidation: If the market reaches this level, the signal's argument is invalidated.
tooltips.abstain: Abstain means evidence was insufficient for either direction.
tooltips.councilDecision: Council decisions are advisory; there is no blind averaging.

agents.title: Agents & departments
agents.subtitle: Twelve departments and their logical agents. No agent can reach real money or an exchange key.
agents.paperOnlyNotice: Each department's budget is paper and only allocates simulated capital.

departments.title: Departments
departments.noAgents: This department has no agent yet.

agents.title: Agents
agents.noRealMoney: No — access to real money is denied system-wide.

empty.title: The org chart did not load
empty.body: Until agent status is read, every department's health stays Unknown.

errors.toggleFailed: The agent state change was not recorded.
errors.stale: Agent status is stale; last update {time}.

tooltips.logicalAgents: Agents are logical roles, not separate processes; all sit under one governance engine.
tooltips.humanGate: Gated actions never run without operator approval.
tooltips.consecutiveErrors: Three consecutive errors move an agent into the degraded state.
tooltips.budget: The paper budget is this department's share of the simulated book.
tooltips.escalation: Level 0 is normal and level 3 is critical; level 3 means escalation to the operator.

risk.title: Risk & kill switch
risk.subtitle: Limits, circuit breakers and the kill switch. This is the only page that can stop the system.
risk.paperOnlyNotice: Every amount and limit on this page is paper; the kill switch halts the simulation only.

level.title: Risk level
level.GREEN: Green — everything is inside the allowed range.
level.AMBER: Amber — we are close to one of the limits.
level.RED: Red — at least one limit has been breached.
level.HALTED: Halted — the decision cycle has stopped.
level.UNKNOWN: Unknown — no data was read to evaluate risk.

limits.title: Risk limits
limits.subtitle: Current value against the approved ceiling.
limits.empty: No limit is defined; without a limit the state is Unknown.

breakers.title: Circuit breakers
breakers.subtitle: Any breaker that trips halts the cycle and writes an audit event.

killSwitch.title: Emergency kill switch
killSwitch.subtitle: Immediate halt of every automatic action. Reset requires a human.
killSwitch.disabled: The kill switch is disabled in this deployment.

haltReasons.title: Halt reasons
haltReasons.none: No halt reason has been recorded.
haltReasons.unknown: The halt reason could not be read.
haltReasons.resumeHint: Resuming is possible only after the reason is cleared and the operator approves.

empty.title: Risk has not been evaluated
empty.body: Until the first cycle completes, the risk level is Unknown. Unknown never means safe.

errors.engageFailed: Engaging the kill switch failed. The state stayed Unknown.
errors.stale: The risk evaluation is stale; last evaluation {time}.
errors.unknownLevel: The risk level is unknown and nothing was substituted.

tooltips.utilization: Current value against the ceiling; above 100 percent means breached.
tooltips.autoReset: A breaker with auto reset re-arms after its cooldown window.
tooltips.cooldown: During cooldown no automatic action runs.
tooltips.killSwitchScope: The scope states exactly what was halted; there is no vague global stop.
tooltips.unknownIsNotSafe: Unknown is a conservative state, not permission to continue.

logs.title: Events & system logs
logs.subtitle: Append-only: events are never edited and never deleted. What you see is what was recorded.

empty.title: No event has been recorded
empty.body: Either no cycle has run or the filters hid every row.
empty.noErrors: No error was recorded in this range.

errors.stale: The event stream is stale; latest event {time}.

tooltips.appendOnly: The event store is append-only; deletion and rewriting are impossible.
tooltips.redacted: Sensitive parts of this event were redacted before storage.
tooltips.traceId: Follow a whole decision chain with this identifier.
tooltips.dataFreshness: Freshness of the data this event was based on.
tooltips.seq: Sequence number in the event store; a jump means an event was missed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance, data policy, execution, alerts and governance.
settings.paperOnlyNotice: The starting balance and limits on this page are paper; changing them does not touch real money.

language.title: Language & format
language.digitsHint: Persian digits are the default; choose Latin to compare against an exchange screen.
language.calendarHint: Data is always stored in UTC; the calendar is a presentation layer only.
language.timeZoneHint: Default: Asia/Tehran. Events are stored in UTC.
language.relativeTimeHint: Show “3 minutes ago” instead of an absolute clock time.

data.title: Data policy
data.principleHint: UNKNOWN beats fabricated: if data cannot be read, a dash is shown, never a zero.
data.demoDataHint: When enabled, the sample pack loads with the Demo label.

execution.title: Execution
execution.modeHint: This value is locked; no other path exists in this build.
execution.liveTradingHint: Real trading would require an exchange key, which this system never stores.
execution.paperStartingBalanceHint: Used only when resetting the simulated book.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.onKillSwitch: When the kill switch is engaged
alerts.onUnknownSpike: On a spike of unknown data

governance.title: Governance
governance.humanGateHint: Irreversible actions never run without operator approval.
governance.immutabilityHint: The event store is append-only and has no delete key.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.subtitle: These actions are irreversible and affect the paper book only.

actions.validationFailed: The entered value is not valid.

empty.title: No settings to show
empty.body: The settings file could not be read; default values are applied.

errors.invalidNumber: The entered number is not valid.
errors.outOfRange: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.permissionDenied: Changing this section requires operator authority.

tooltips.stalenessBudget: If an observation is older than this budget, its state moves from Live to Stale.
tooltips.demoData: Demo data is always shown with the Demo label.
tooltips.modeLocked: This value cannot be changed; AHOS is paper-only in this build.

operator.title: Operator desk
operator.subtitle: Human control: approvals, the kill switch and shift status. Nothing irreversible happens without your approval.
operator.paperOnlyNotice: Every amount in the tasks on this page is paper; your authority applies to the simulated book only.

tasks.title: Tasks awaiting approval
tasks.subtitle: An unapproved task expires; it is never auto-approved.
tasks.empty: No task is waiting for approval.
tasks.requiresPhrase: This task requires typing a confirmation phrase.

empty.title: No operator is on shift
empty.body: Without an operator, human-gated actions stay pending and then expire.

errors.decideFailed: Recording the decision failed; the task is still pending.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have authority for this action.
errors.stale: The operator desk is stale; last action {time}.

tooltips.expiry: An expired task is never auto-approved; it has to be requested again.
tooltips.phrase: Typing the confirmation phrase prevents accidental clicks on dangerous actions.
tooltips.auditTrail: Every approval and rejection is recorded with time and actor in the audit events.
tooltips.noRealMoney: Operator authority in this build never reaches real money.

discovery.name: Discovery & Watch
discovery.mission: Continuously scan markets and pull out candidates, without inflating the count.

marketData.name: Market Data
marketData.mission: Read price, volume and liquidity from allowed sources and record the freshness of each observation.

onchain.name: On-chain & Whales
onchain.mission: Inspect holder distribution, whale movement and supply concentration on chain.

security.name: Token & Contract Security
security.mission: Detect honeypots, sell restrictions and dangerous permissions; Unknown is never assumed to be safe.

newsMacro.name: News & Macro
newsMacro.mission: Collect news events and macro indicators with source and timestamp attached.

research.name: Research & Methodology
research.mission: Design testable hypotheses and review method quality before any conclusion.

quant.name: Quant & Backtesting
quant.mission: Test rules against historical data with a cost model and no look-ahead.

council.name: Expert Council
council.mission: Advisory judgement over evidence; no blind averaging and dissent is recorded.

risk.name: Risk Management
risk.mission: Guard limits, circuit breakers and position sizing; halt before disaster.

paperExecution.name: Paper Execution
paperExecution.mission: Simulate orders realistically with slippage, fees and liquidity constraints.

learning.name: Learning & Memory
learning.mission: Record the lesson of every closed trade and keep decision memory, without silently changing rules.

auditGovernance.name: Audit & Governance
auditGovernance.mission: Preserve the event chain, hold veto power over final results and keep status reports honest.

killSwitchEngage.title: Halt the whole system
killSwitchEngage.body: Engaging the kill switch immediately stops signal intake, paper order submission and automatic exits. Open positions are not closed; only automatic action stops.
killSwitchEngage.warning: This action is written to the audit events and cannot be reset without human approval.
killSwitchEngage.reasonPlaceholder: For example: spike of unknown data in the price feed
killSwitchEngage.checkboxLabel: I accept that the automatic cycle stays halted until a manual reset.
killSwitchEngage.phraseMismatch: The phrase you typed does not match the required one.
killSwitchEngage.success: Kill switch engaged; every automatic action is halted.
killSwitchEngage.failure: Engaging the kill switch failed. The state is Unknown and must be checked manually.

killSwitchReset.title: Reset the kill switch
killSwitchReset.body: Resetting lets the system resume its paper cycle. The reason for the halt must be cleared first.
killSwitchReset.requirementReason: The halt reason has been cleared.
killSwitchReset.requirementRisk: The risk level has been reviewed and recorded.
killSwitchReset.requirementLogs: Events from the halted window have been reviewed.
killSwitchReset.checkboxLabel: I have completed the checks above.
killSwitchReset.success: Kill switch reset; cycles are resuming.
killSwitchReset.failure: Reset failed; the kill switch is still engaged.

killSwitchDrill.title: Halt drill
killSwitchDrill.body: A drill exercises the halt path without changing the persistent state. The result is written to the audit events.
killSwitchDrill.failure: The drill did not complete; the halt path is not reliable.

closePosition.title: Close a paper position
closePosition.body: Position {symbol} will be closed in the paper book. This affects the simulation only.
closePosition.realizableWarning: Realizable value may be lower than displayed value; slippage, fee and tax are modelled in the simulation.
closePosition.checkboxLabel: I understand this trade is paper and no real money moves.
closePosition.success: The position was closed in the paper book.
closePosition.failure: Closing the position failed; it is still open.
closePosition.unexitable: This position cannot be exited in the simulation: {reason}

trimPosition.title: Trim a paper position
trimPosition.body: Part of position {symbol} will be closed.
trimPosition.validation: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
trimPosition.success: Part of the position was closed.

adjustStop.title: Adjust the stop loss
adjustStop.body: The stop of position {symbol} changes. The exit rule is evaluated against the new level from now on.
adjustStop.validation: The new stop must keep a sensible distance from the entry price.

cancelOrder.title: Cancel a paper order
cancelOrder.body: Order {id} is removed from the simulator queue.
cancelOrder.warning: If the order filled before the cancel, the cancel has no effect.

approveTask.title: Approve a request
approveTask.body: Approving runs the requested action in the paper book and records it in the audit events.
approveTask.requiresPhrase: This request requires typing a confirmation phrase.
approveTask.failure: Running the request failed; the task is still pending.
approveTask.expired: This task has expired and cannot be approved.

rejectTask.title: Reject a request
rejectTask.body: The request is rejected and the requester must come back with fresh evidence.

disableAgent.title: Disable an agent
disableAgent.body: Agent {name} leaves the cycle. It produces no output until re-enabled and its department may turn Unknown.
disableAgent.impactSignals: New signals from this agent stop.
disableAgent.impactLogs: The disable event is written to the audit trail.

enableAgent.title: Enable an agent
enableAgent.body: Agent {name} rejoins the cycle. Its first output appears after one full cycle.

raiseLimit.title: Raise a risk limit
raiseLimit.body: This request changes the {limit} ceiling. Raising a limit affects the paper book only and is recorded in the audit trail.
raiseLimit.warning: Raising a ceiling weakens the circuit breaker.
raiseLimit.checkboxLabel: I have recorded the reason for this change in the audit trail.

resetPaperBook.title: Reset the paper book
resetPaperBook.body: All positions, orders and paper P&L history are cleared and the book restarts from the starting balance.
resetPaperBook.warning: This action is irreversible. Audit events are not cleared.
resetPaperBook.checkboxLabel: I understand the paper history will be lost.

clearLocalData.title: Clear local data
clearLocalData.body: Settings stored in the browser and cached data are cleared.

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.body: If you leave this page, unsaved changes are lost.

exportData.title: Export data
exportData.body: Choose the range and format. Unknown data is exported as an empty value, never as zero.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.body: Sign in again to continue with approval tasks. The data on screen does not turn Unknown.

dangerZoneAck.title: This section is dangerous
dangerZoneAck.body: Actions here are irreversible and affect the paper book only.

toasts.unknownResult: The result of this action is unknown; check the events.

tradeVenue.title: Trade venue · paper
tradeVenue.note: Paper positions; no real money is involved
tradeVenue.pageStatusTitle: Status of this page itself: demo / paper data

notice.demo: All rows are demo rows and never enter the real-paper total.
notice.forced: The DEMO label was forced with ?demo=1.
notice.withheld: {n} rows were not read and are withheld from view.
notice.gap: Some rows have unknown data; no number is invented for them.

row.demoTitle: This row is demo data, not a citable live feed
row.violationDemo: This violation was reported by the demo adapter

sum.resultMissing: Nothing to show: demo and unknown rows are excluded from the total.
sum.resultNote: Only authorized, non-demo rows are included in this total.
